cases.name: Corina Zukowski-Rodriguez
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Corina loved and lived with no boundaries. She loved her family, including her brother and sisters, and most importantly, her three boys. Corina had a special sense of humor and was not afraid to have fun by being silly. She also had a deep love of music. Corina loved to make people happy and was always willing to do anything that was asked of her. During the summer, you could usually find Corina teaching the boys how to swim in the family pool before sunbathing with olive oil and of course, regretting it later. Corina was well known for her various facial expressions that made everyone cry with laughter. She was forgiving and loyal to a fault, yet never allowed that to stop her from being who she was."
cases.narrative: Stab wounds to the neck, hands and chest.
